newsitem.title: UK: SOCCER-DERBY SET TO SIGN AC MILAN'S ERANIO.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-DERBY SET TO SIGN AC MILAN'S ERANIO.

text.p: English premier league club Derby County are set to sign Italian international midfielder Stefano Eranio from AC Milan.
A Derby spokesman said on Friday they expect the deal to be completed on Monday.
The 30-year-old former Genoa player is out of contract in the summer and has agreed a three-year-deal with Derby manager Jim Smith.
Eranio has been with Milan for five seasons.
He has also made 30 appearances for Italy and is expected to add to that total during the Tournoi de France next month when Italy play England, Brazil and France.
